Bought this game even seeing all the bad reviews. The game itself is not horrible, but the issues with it will start to upset you at some point. Firstly, yes the hackers are very annoying but like most other games I assumed they would be there. I didn't think there be as many as there are though. The zombies mode is my favorite of all so far. There are some real drawbacks though. Zombie mode is only 3 players to a team unlike the prior versions. At least once everyday in the zombie mode, the lobby will crash and you will lose everything you don't have in a stash. There are many glitches within that mode that I have seen people get very upset over because they lost all their gear. I have a larger group of friends that play with me and they have also had the same issues so I know it is not just me. I would give this 3 out of 5. If you are someone who gets upset because you found an item you have been working toward for game progression and then the game crashes before you can exfil and you lose your gear and have to work your way back. Then do not get this game. I think this could be a great game if they fixed some of the issues.

So if i was actually over the two hours, i get it, but that's not what happened.
Steam claimed i had something like 18 hours of playtime, but the only possible way that makes sense is if they added all of my Warzone time on top of my MW3 time. I tried to address this several times, but steam wouldn't bother to review it beyond automated responses.

So just to be clear, if you own any other titles under the call of duty name, you will not get a refund no matter what.

TL:DR, game good, worth playing.

As someone who started playing this game on the tail end of season 1, all the way through, it is 100% worth playing. The multiplayer is fantastic, fast paced, and there are quite literally over one hundred weapons to choose from, not even including the aftermarkert part system which turns some guns into something complelely new (Like turning the MORS sniper, which is a single shot sniper, into a blunderbuss. Turning the M4 into a .50 Cal marksmen rifle because fuck it, why not?)

The zombies experience, while not like the traditional COD zombies experience, is quite fun. The community that has stayed to play this game is always helping new players. The gameplay loop is simple, but addicting by either grinding contracts or simply roaming the world just killing the pockets of zombies that spawn in.

Also, if you like camo grinding holy shit there are ALOT to grind for. 984 universal camos, not even including the mastery camos themselves. Plus, if you really like just a singular gun there is a weapon prestige camo grind as well, that is just gaining weapon xp.

Never played the campaign, have no comments about it.
